import sys
from itertools import combinations

def cross(O, A, B):
    return (A[0]-O[0])*(B[1]-O[1]) - (A[1]-O[1])*(B[0]-O[0])

def intersect_halfplane(poly, px, py, dx, dy):
    # Keep points on the left side of line through (px,py) with direction (dx,dy)
    # i.e., cross product (d x (point - p)) >= 0
    result = []
    n = len(poly)
    for i in range(n):
        A = poly[i]
        B = poly[(i+1)%n]
        # sign for A and B
        sA = dx*(A[1]-py) - dy*(A[0]-px)
        sB = dx*(B[1]-py) - dy*(B[0]-px)
        if sA >= -1e-9:
            result.append(A)
        if (sA > 1e-9 and sB < -1e-9) or (sA < -1e-9 and sB > 1e-9):
            # intersection
            t = (dx*(A[1]-py)-dy*(A[0]-px)) / (dx*(A[1]-B[1])-dy*(A[0]-B[0]))
            ix = A[0] + t*(B[0]-A[0])
            iy = A[1] + t*(B[1]-A[1])
            result.append((ix, iy))
    return result

def polygon_area(poly):
    n = len(poly)
    area = 0
    for i in range(n):
        j = (i+1)%n
        area += poly[i][0]*poly[j][1]
        area -= poly[j][0]*poly[i][1]
    return abs(area)/2

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx+=1
    island = []
    for _ in range(n):
        x,y = float(data[idx]),float(data[idx+1]); idx+=2
        island.append((x,y))
    
    m = int(data[idx]); idx+=1
    sites = []
    for _ in range(m):
        x,y = float(data[idx]),float(data[idx+1]); idx+=2
        sites.append((x,y))
    
    # Ensure island is CCW
    if polygon_area(island) == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    # Check orientation
    area_signed = 0
    for i in range(n):
        j=(i+1)%n
        area_signed += island[i][0]*island[j][1] - island[j][0]*island[i][1]
    if area_signed < 0:
        island = island[::-1]
    
    areas = []
    for i, si in enumerate(sites):
        cell = list(island)
        for j, sj in enumerate(sites):
            if i == j: continue
            # Perpendicular bisector: midpoint M, normal direction (sj - si)
            mx = (si[0]+sj[0])/2
            my = (si[1]+sj[1])/2
            # Half-plane: points closer to si
            # (p - M) · (sj - si) <= 0
            # Normal pointing from si to sj: (dx,dy) = sj-si
            # We want (p-M)·n <= 0, i.e., left side when direction is perpendicular
            dx = sj[0]-si[0]
            dy = sj[1]-si[1]
            # Half-plane: keep points where (p-M)·(si-sj) >= 0
            # Direction along bisector: perpendicular to (dx,dy) = (-dy, dx)
            # Left of line through M in direction (-dy,dx) means...
            # Use: keep where cross((-dy,dx), p-M) >= 0
            # cross = (-dy)*(py-my) - (dx)*(px-mx) ... let me redo
            # We want: (p-M)·(si-sj) >= 0 => (-dx*(px-mx) - dy*(py-my)) >= 0
            # Line direction: perpendicular to (dx,dy) is (-dy, dx)
            cell = intersect_halfplane(cell, mx, my, -dy, dx)
            # Wait, need correct halfplane
            if not cell:
                break
        areas.append(polygon_area(cell))
    
    for a in areas:
        print(f"{a:.4f}")

solve()
